images.seen: 31 culture polygons, all in plausible regions (Green Sahara, Hoabinhian, Aboriginal Australians, Ubaid, Kelteminar, Jomon, LBK/Lengyel in central Europe, Sredny Stog founded); Cliopatria has 0 shapes in this period so the comparison pane is empty.

Lengyel (Hungary, Slovakia, Czechia incl. Bohemia, plus a detached Kuyavia/Greater Poland piece), Sredny Stog, Cucuteni-Trypillia, Ubaid, Atlantic megalith builders all in their regions; no speckle, no stray cells; central and western Germany, Rhine and Bavaria are nobody's after the LBK dissolve (Rossen has no dossier).
Yangshao, Beixin, Hongshan, Daxi, Majiabang, Hemudu, Jeulmun, Jomon and Hoabinhian drawn in plausible places with no overlaps or holes; Cliopatria pane empty (0 shapes).

issues.what: The only changing year, -4500, is explained by dossier events (Sredny Stog and Anau founded; LBK, Vinca, Jeitun and Zhaobaogou dissolved; Bohemia and central Poland pass from LBK to Lengyel). No conflicts, snaps, skipped events or unresolved regions in the packet.

About 2,300 cells of the former LBK land (Rhine, Elbe, Bavaria, Lower Saxony) become nobody's from the end of -4500 although the LBK page names successor cultures (Rossen, Hinkelstein, Grossgartach) there; the LBK dossier itself notes they have no dossier. Rossen is dated 4600-4300 BC over 'Germany except north, Low Countries, northeast France, north Switzerland and Austria'. A whole state is missing, which a patch cannot fix.

patch_check: no patch written (nothing clearly wrong that a patch could fix)

dossier_requests.what: New dossier for the Rossen culture, c. 4600-4300 BC (start -4600, end -4300), Central Europe: Germany except the north, Low Countries (southeast), northeast France, northern Switzerland and a small part of Austria; predecessor linear-pottery-culture (Hinkelstein, Grossgartach and Planig-Friedberg intervene in the west). It would fill the land the LBK dossier releases to nobody at the end of -4500 (Rhine, Elbe, Bavaria, Lower Saxony). Note it starts 100 years before the LBK ends, so the LBK keyframe -4800..-4500 would overlap it in -4600..-4500 and need a ruling or a trimmed LBK keyframe.
dossier_requests.why: Map shows western and central Germany as nobody's land from -4500 although Rossen held it; the LBK dossier already records that Rossen, Hinkelstein and Grossgartach have no dossier.

problems: Rossen's start (-4600) is before this window; its dossier request touches m4600-m4501 as well, where the LBK keyframe -4800 to -4500 would collide with it.
Cliopatria has 0 shapes alive in -4500..-4401, so --compare-cliopatria shows nothing; the check rests on the pages and the dossiers only.
